units.source_text: 月色澄碧，了无荫翳，晓雾也遮蔽不住，清光射入室中。

en.t: The moonlight was clear and blue, with no shadow to dim it; even the dawn mist could not cover it, and its pure light streamed into the room.

units.source_text: 山庄厢屋甚浅，似觉与室外无甚间隔。

en.t: The side room of the mountain villa was so shallow that it felt almost without any separation from the outdoors.

units.source_text: 公主觉得脸面正对月亮，怪难为情，竭力回避，其态度之娇媚难于形容。

en.t: The princess felt as if her face were directly turned toward the moon, and, terribly embarrassed, she tried hard to avoid it; her shy grace was beyond description.

units.source_text: 夕雾约略说起柏木生前之事，神情从容不迫。

en.t: Yugiri briefly spoke of matters from Kashiwagi's lifetime, his manner calm and unhurried.

units.source_text: 但他觉得公主对他不及对柏木之重视，不免向她诉恨。

en.t: But feeling that the princess valued him less than she had valued Kashiwagi, he could not help voicing his resentment to her.

units.source_text: 公主心中寻思：“我的故夫官位不及此人之高，但婚事乃父母之命，自然名正言顺。

en.t: The princess thought to herself, "My late husband's rank was not as high as this man's, but our marriage was arranged by our parents, so it was naturally proper and legitimate.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，我犹且身受丈夫冷遇。

en.t: Even so, I still suffered cold treatment from my husband.

units.source_text: 何况此人，岂可冒昧相从？

en.t: How then could I rashly give myself to this man?

units.source_text: 加之他不是外人，我翁前太政大臣是他的岳丈，如果闻知此事，不知作何感想。

en.t: Moreover, he is no outsider: my father-in-law, the former Grand Minister, is his father-in-law as well, and if he hears of this, who knows what he will think.

units.source_text: 一般世间的讥评且不必说，我父朱雀院闻知此事，将何等伤心！”

en.t: To say nothing of ordinary gossip and blame from the world, how deeply my father, the Suzaku Retired Emperor, would grieve if he learned of it!"

units.source_text: 她一一考虑关系深切的诸人，觉得此事实甚可恨。

en.t: Thinking one by one of all those closely connected with her, she felt this whole affair was truly hateful.

units.source_text: 她自己虽然坚守贞节，奈何世人谣诼纷传！

en.t: Although she herself firmly guarded her chastity, what could she do when rumors spread everywhere among people?

units.source_text: 老夫人此刻尚未得知，实在对她不起。

en.t: The old lady had not yet learned of it, and the princess felt truly ashamed before her.

units.source_text: 将来知道了，定将责备她不知大义，真乃痛苦之事。

en.t: When she found out later, she would surely reproach her for not understanding what duty required, and that would be a truly painful thing.

units.source_text: 因此她只管催促夕雾早归：“务请在天明之前回去！”

en.t: For this reason she simply kept urging Yugiri to leave quickly: "Please, you must go back before daybreak!"

units.source_text: 此外别无言语。

en.t: Beyond that, she had nothing else to say.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“公主太无情了！

en.t: Yugiri answered, "Princess, you are too heartless!

units.source_text: 教我像定情之后似的在天色未明之前踏着朝露回去，岂不被朝露耻笑！

en.t: If you make me go home before dawn, treading through the morning dew as though we had pledged ourselves to each other, will even the dew not laugh at me?

units.source_text: 还得请你明白了解我的心情。

en.t: You must still try to understand my feelings clearly.

units.source_text: 你倘待我如此冷酷，巧妙地哄骗我早些离去，那时我禁压不住心中业火，会不知不觉地做出种种不成样子的事情来呢。”

en.t: If you treat me so coldly and cleverly coax me into leaving early, then I may be unable to suppress the fire in my heart and, without realizing it, do all sorts of disgraceful things."

units.source_text: 他实在恋恋不舍，经公主催促，反而不想回去了。

en.t: He was truly reluctant to part from her, and when the princess urged him on, he became even less willing to leave.

units.source_text: 但此人的确不惯于色情行为，觉得过分非礼，对人不起。

en.t: Yet this man was indeed unaccustomed to affairs of love, and he felt that going too far would be improper and unfair to her.

units.source_text: 而被人看轻，亦甚可耻。

en.t: And to be looked down upon by others would also be deeply shameful.

units.source_text: 为人为己打算，还不如乘人不觉之时冒着朝雾回去为是。

en.t: For both her sake and his own, it would be better to leave through the morning mist before anyone noticed.

units.source_text: 然而已经神不守舍了。

en.t: By then, however, his heart was already in a complete tumult.

units.source_text: 吟诗云：

en.t: He composed a poem and said:
